div.head: Abt 55
div.ab: Bei den Nägeln, bei allen [vom 2.–5. Finger kostet Abhauen je 1] Schilling.
For the nails, for all of them [from the 2nd to the 5th finger, cutting off costs 1] shilling [each].
For the nails of each [of the above-mentioned fingers], 1 shilling [shall be paid as compensation].
For each of the nails, a shilling.

note.seg: Ausser dem des Daumens laut 54, 1; vgl. Gl Fingernagel 2
Except that of the thumb, according to 54, 1; cf. Gl Fingernagel 2
